calculation: reported overall = round(raw composite - penalty total, 2)

rules.Split-detector dampener: −1.50 applied when at least one of the five detectors still returned ≥20% AI on 10% or more of that tool’s samples, even if the blended bypass rate was high. Not applied to NoteGPT because failure was unanimous, not split — that cost is already inside the 18.4 bypass score, plus the residual-AI flag.
rules.Length / verbosity flag: Up to −1.50 when median output length exceeded the source by more than 12% on the academic or report subsets (inflated sentences that can look human to detectors but hurt tightness).
rules.Meaning-nick / drift flag: Up to −1.00 when embedding similarity dropped below 0.86 on a sample or a human rater marked a factual/intent change. StealthGPT, BypassGPT, and Netus picked up most of these.
rules.Residual AI-pattern flag: Up to −2.80 for leftover template cadence: tricolon stacking, empty intensifiers, identical paragraph openings across reruns. NoteGPT kept source LLM cadence almost intact, which is why this flag is large there.
rules.Rerun variance flag: Up to −0.50 when three reruns of the same input produced bypass swings larger than 15 points on the 40-sample stability subset.
rules.What it is not: Reported Overall is not min-max normalized across the field, not divided by 100, and not computed with an older weight set. Weights stayed 40/25/20/15 for the whole September cycle. The only subtraction after the weighted sum is the penalty column.
rules.Rounding: Raw composite kept to 3 decimals internally. Penalties kept to 2 decimals. Reported Overall = round(raw − penalties, 2). Tiny 0.005-level remainders were absorbed into the penalty total so the published table matches exactly.
